GUIDE: Dev Tools --> Security Tab

Open the dev tools tab with CTRL + SHIFT + J and navigate to the security tab. A Security tab does not exist in Firefox.

Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome support this in the dev tools.

A details summary of the current page is provided. Also, cryptography algorithm information about the HTTPS certificate and TLS 1.3 connection is given.

Clicking "Open full certificate details" opens the same panel as opening it via the URL icon option.

Go to <GUIDE: HTTPS> for more.
